identity: Blade of the House of Spiders Ryōshū
frame_indexing: Zero-based source decoded frame. End frames exclusive. Source PTS = frame * 1001 / 30000.
accuracy: Contacts denote first visible intersection/impact, not hidden engine damage ticks. Native neighborhoods resolve listed events to source frames; other envelope transitions sampled every two source frames have up to one-frame uncertainty. Coin mappings are hypotheses without HUD.
scale: H = standing caster body height in the SAME shot. Distances are screen-plane estimates; not inferred from effect length.
color_note: Hex colors are visual palette approximations, not calibrated pixel measurements.
sheet_note: overview sheets are 6 fps; detail sheets select even source frames (~14.985 fps). detail f-label is SAMPLE index, not source frame; use timestamp. Native sheets label actual SRC frame; windows may be discontinuous.
name: Tripleslash

evidence: Three target-contact groups at frames 373, 391, 413; direct blade passes; all Slash compatible.
The crescent at 12.012 s is a preparatory swing at caster position: target is still separated, so it is not counted as an extra hit.
alternatives: S2 also has three Slash coins; without a name banner S1/S2 cannot be proven solely from count.

weapon.type: Long narrow curved single-edged sword; katana/nodachi-like silhouette, with separate dark scabbard
weapon.held: One hand controls hilt in visible dash poses; other hand manages scabbard. Exact fingers/grip obscured in motion. Two separated hands support sword/scabbard assembly above head in overhead poses.

parts_colors.hilt: dark violet #26233D with pale diagonal wrapping #A7A3BC
parts_colors.cord: thin dark cord at hilt/scabbard; red ribbons/threads accompany body

weapon.measurement_note: Screen-space estimates from chibi sprite; camera scaling and foreshortening preclude exact world dimensions.

props.count_visible: 2–4 overlapping impressions, not separate physical weapons
props.note: No projectile detaches from the blade.

caster_motion.description: Plant feet and draw/sweep in place, displacement <0.5 H.
Dash right about 3–4 H to target; crouched trailing recovery.
Dash through to right side about 3 H; blade extended.
Reverse across target about 3–4 H; stop low on its left.
Hold crouched recovery; upright idle at frame 448.

hits.contact: Curved blade and cyan vertical edge intersect target on first forward pass
Horizontal blade/cyan cutting trail crosses target torso
Return pass through target; red radial blood/flower-like burst behind victim

beats.description: Wind-up: low hip blade, enlarged body impressions, blue glint then rising navy/cyan crescent at caster; no target contact yet.
Hit 1, upright cyan flare on victim; violet/cyan arcs multiply behind dash and thin away.
White circular speed smear; frame 390 is target close-up before contact.
Hit 2, horizontal streak and white spiral ribbon; ground dust; caster stops beyond victim.
Two-frame floor/framing punch at 410–411; frame 412 extreme speed smear.
Hit 3, red radial burst and blue threads; camera backs out while victim collapses.
Dust fades, crouched recovery, upright at 448.

effects.shape: glint, spiky orb, then broad rising crescent
effects.motion: arc follows blade upward; dark interior under bright rim

effects.shape: nested open elliptical arcs plus narrow target cross
white wind ball, cyan horizontal line and orbiting ribbons
effects.motion: ribbons stretch along travel; dust remains at ground

effects.shape: red radial petal/blood disk, blue lines, red body silhouettes
effects.position: behind victim and along caster path
effects.motion: disk opens outward; silhouettes lag caster

camera.framing: Side-on slight downward pitch; caster ~0.35 image height, victim off right.
Track right; both full bodies, baseline y≈0.65.
Target enlarged to ~0.8 frame height for 3 source frames.
Caster traverses victim then stops to right.
410–411 floor/target edge; 412 speed smear fills frame.
Victim center-right, caster left; back out to arena.

coin_comparison.note: Visual contact groups do not establish hidden game damage events. Null coins retain unresolved mapping.
